services.name: Actor_ApplyRandomSpawnVariation
services.behavior: The helper calls TerrainScene5RandomStep, masks the result to three bits, subtracts three, and adds the signed result to actor A5 offset 0x02. A second random value controls animation-root replacement at offset 0x20 through bit 0 and sets actor offset 0x35 through bit 1.

services.name: InteractionSpawn_RuntimeType40
services.behavior: Calls LevelObjectSpawnVariant with template 0x001B79B8. If allocation succeeds, writes type 0x40, animation root 0x00122C12, and zero to actor offset 0x29.
services.parent_pattern: The caller adjusts the destination actor coordinates around four calls, producing a four-position type-0x40 spawn pattern when its display-counter gate is satisfied.
